info.name: Create an account integration with Konekt

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETAConfigure an integration on the account with Newforma Konekt. Requires the permission `account:integrations:write` automatically granted for account administrators and account owner.

info.name: Get an account integration with Konekt

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETAGet an integration with Newforma Konekt configured on the account Requires the permission `account:integrations:read` automatically granted for account administrators and account owner.

info.name: Update an account integration with Konekt

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETAUpdate the configuration for the integration with Newforma Konekt. Requires the permission `account:integrations:write` automatically granted for account administrators and account owner.

info.name: Delete an account integration with Konekt

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETADelete an integration with Newforma Konekt on the account. Requires the permission `account:integrations:write` automatically granted for account administrators and account owner.

info.name: Connect an account integration with Konekt

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETAConnect an integration previously disconnected. Requires the permission `account:integrations:write` automatically granted for account administrators and account owner.

info.name: Disconnect an account integration with Konekt

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETADisconnect an integration without removing it. Requires the permission `account:integrations:write` automatically granted for account administrators and account owner.

info.name: Get configuration of integration with Konekt on a Project

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

params.name: projectRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the project

items.docs: BETAGet the integration with Newforma Konekt configured on the project Requires the permission `project:integrations:read` automatically granted for users having `workzone:annotations:write` on the root work zone of the project.
